version: African LD shared causal variant benchmark 3
phenotypes: Continuous systolic blood pressure proxy and binary depression proxy, both wholly simulated; full structural equations in source and manuscript
primary_coloc: Separate fixed participant halves, single-causal ABF enumeration, p1=p2=1e-4, p12=1e-5, prior SD .15 continuous residual units and .20 log OR
shared_tag_test: Bonferroni across 64 markers of max(p_cardio,p_mental), using HC0 standard errors; association with both traits at the same marker does not establish one causal variant
calibration: Within population region regime, worst-case order-statistic cutoff across no-shared scenarios for PP4; strict comparison, no evaluation tuning
copula_panel: First 20 evaluation replicates of every cell and scenario; unchanged original varying-dependence Gaussian/probit sandwich test at prespecified anchor; nominal diagnostic only, no shared-causal interpretation
missingness: Realistic regime MAR conditional on fitted age and exposure; complete case analysis
failures: Main failures retained as no discovery in attempted denominators; any calibration main failure blocks threshold creation; copula diagnostic failures separately counted
inference_scope: Known simulated shared direct genetic effects, not causal effects of one disease on another, not real patient evidence, not genome-wide calibration
replicate_uncertainty: Wilson conditional intervals; 400 joint calibration/evaluation bootstrap replicates for aggregate claims; all prespecified alternatives retained
